method: Built-in image_gen tool; screenshot-based editorial compositing and stage annotations
scope: Edited explanatory graphics, not unmodified screenshots or recordings. Original screenshots remain separately available. English labels explain the Chinese source conversation.

assets.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create a polished editorial walkthrough graphic by EDITING AND ARRANGING the two supplied real UI screenshots. Image 1 is the actual Codex conversation showing plan, Deng handoff, progress and a context-limit interruption. Image 2 is the actual completion message and correction card. Output a crisp high-resolution landscape graphic, approximately 2048 by 1536, with four numbered panels in a balanced 2x2 grid. Restrained warm off-white background, deep navy text, teal accents, generous whitespace, neat typography. Every panel combines one short editorial caption OUTSIDE a generously sized crop of the relevant source screenshot. Use the actual source screenshot snippets as visual inserts, crop and zoom for legibility; do not invent additional UI states, change the selected worker model, erase the context-limit interruption, or claim Deng did all the work. Preserve original Chinese screenshot text within the source inserts; NEVER translate text inside the original UI. Do not include any product version, currency savings, fabricated metrics, URLs, browser address bars or private paths. No photorealistic people or decoration. Add a small but readable source note explaining this is an edited, annotated walkthrough based on supplied screenshots, with original screenshots available separately. Important factual boundary: Deng implemented animation and sound; Codex planned, corrected, did final rendering and acceptance. All editorial labels and captions must be Simplified Chinese. Main title exact: "从方案到成片". Subtitle exact: "在 Codex 中设计，用 Deng 执行，再回到 Codex 验收". Four panel headings exact: "01 设计方案", "02 委派执行", "03 跟进与调整", "04 修正与交付". Captions respectively: "明确分镜与分阶段检查"; "Deng 使用单独配置的执行模型"; "保留进度和上下文限制的真实反馈"; "Codex 完成修正、最终渲染与验收". Use Image 1 top excerpt for panel 1, its handoff/model excerpt for panel 2, its lower interruption excerpt for panel 3, and Image 2 completion and correction card for panel 4. Footer exact: "DNA 科普短片实例 · 120 秒 · 原始交付 1080p". Source note exact: "依据真实截图编辑整理 · 原始截图另附".
